description: This PHP script manages test project editing, creation, updating, deletion, and related UI initialization for the TestLink project management system. It includes functions for handling form input, database interactions, and rendering templates for project management tasks.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP object used for passing data structures.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input arguments from request and session for project management operations.

methods.name: prepareOptions
methods.description: Collects and prepares project options from input arguments.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new test project, including linking trackers and copying requirements if needed.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing test project with new data, manages tracker links, and logs events.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a test project, populating form fields with current project info.

methods.name: crossChecks
methods.description: Performs validation checks for project name and prefix uniqueness during create/update.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes default values and prepares the UI for creating a new test project.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a test project and logs the deletion event.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI data structures, including rights and related entity lists.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for managing projects.
